title: HDG methods in finite element exterior calculus
summary: We develop and analyze HDG methods for two central problems in finite element exterior calculus, the Hodge-Dirac problem and the Hodge-Laplace problem, in arbitrary dimension $n$. Our analysis allows for equal-order polynomial spaces with $\mathcal{O}(1)$ penalty parameters, by contrast with previous work on the Hodge-Laplace problem requiring an underlying conforming complex and $\mathcal{O}(h)$ or $\mathcal{O}(h^{-1})$ penalties. For the Hodge-Dirac problem with degree-$r$ polynomials, our error estimates give optimal order-$(r+1)$ convergence in all form degrees under suitable regularity…
